versions.content: LdCom: Only EventControlledTiming with no repetition defined The ISignal is mapped into an ISignalIPdu . Only if this ISignalIPdu has an EventControlledTiming (via TransmissionModeTiming . eventCon- trolledTiming ) with EventControlledTiming . numberOfRepetitions = 0 de- fined and the LdCom module is present, this ISignal shall be handled by LdCom.
